facts.business: RGF Capital Markets Limited is a non-deposit taking NBFC registered with RBI, primarily focused on providing inter-corporate loans, personal loans, loans against shares & securities, loans against properties, trading in shares & securities, and arbitrage business in stock and commodity markets.
key_risks: Economic Downturn: If the economic downturn is prolonged, it can reduce the financing needs of people due to shrinking business opportunities.
Private Banks: Private banks are also working on a similar business model as NBFCs, thereby giving very strong competition to NBFCs.
RBI and Government restrictions: More stringent norms governing the functioning of NBFCs and certain government restrictions act as a hindrance to the smooth functioning of NBFCs.
Branding: Our Company is not a well-established brand among large NBFC players who have access to larger financial resources.
Accessibility: We do not have branches, so we are unable to explore business opportunities in other areas.
